caption: See what's going out, what's live and what needs you, at a glance.
feature_body: The dashboard shows how many posts are waiting, what went out this week and anything that failed, with your next posts and connected accounts right beside them.

caption: Write once and see exactly how it looks on every network.
feature_body: Pick the accounts, add your text and a photo, and switch between previews that look like X, Instagram, Facebook, Threads and LinkedIn before anything goes out.

caption: Plan your whole week on one calendar.
feature_body: Every scheduled and published post sits on a weekly calendar, so you can spot gaps, filter by network and keep a steady rhythm.

caption: Connect X, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, TikTok and LinkedIn.
feature_body: Connect each social account once and post to any of them from a single screen. You can see at a glance that each one is connected and ready.

caption: Track how much you're posting and where.
feature_body: See how many posts went out over the last 7, 30 or 90 days compared with the period before, and which accounts you post to most.

caption: From idea to scheduled post in under 20 seconds.
feature_body: Write your post, choose where it goes, check the previews and pick a time. It shows up on your calendar straight away and goes out on its own.

caption: Preview your post the way each network will show it.
feature_body: Switch between networks to see your text and images as your followers will, so every post looks right everywhere.
